g.text: Production Modular Monolith • Spring Boot 4.0.0 (Java 17) • React 19 SPA • PostgreSQL 15 • Redis 7 • Docker Compose
Roster, Attendance Pills, SLA Amenity Request
Strict REST polling • Zero WebSocket overhead
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED Row Locks
• Scans deliveryDeadline (5 min SLA) & flags breach
• Repositories: User, Class, Enrollment, Staff, Amenity
• Optimized Queries: JOIN FETCH, Projection DTOs
• PostgreSQL JDBC driver with connection pooling
• Exported pool metrics to Micrometer & Prometheus
• FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED row locking
SELECT s FROM Staff s WHERE s.available = true
AND s.department = :dept FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Guarantees zero double-booking under concurrent administrator/dispatcher assignments.
FIFO AMENITY LOGISTICS & DUAL SLA GOVERNANCE WORKFLOW
IN-APP NOTIFICATIONS: POSTGRESQL PERSISTENCE + REST POLLING
